final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS f, AVG((sp.boxy - sp.boxx) * 1.0 / sp.boxx) AS c2, SUM(sp.aream2) * 1.0 / SUM(sp.volm3) AS c3 FROM scanspatial sp JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = sp.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c3) AS a FROM s1) SELECT s1.f, s1.c2, s1.c3, s1.c3 - s2.a FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c3 > s2.a
